memories.label: pluribus_mcp_primary_interface_constraint
memories.statement: Pluribus MCP is the primary agent interface; agents must use recall_context and record_experience through MCP tools rather than ad-hoc file reads for durable memory.

memories.label: pluribus_phase1_mcp_proof_pattern
memories.statement: Phase 1 MCP proof validated recall_context and record_experience as the minimal viable agent memory loop with compile-time bundle assembly.

memories.label: pluribus_agent_loop_contract_context
memories.statement: The agent loop contract requires recall before non-trivial work and record_experience after meaningful outcomes; skipping the loop violates Pluribus compliance.

memories.label: pluribus_recall_benchmark_work_pattern
memories.statement: Recall benchmark fixtures live under control-plane/testdata/recall_benchmark with labeled memories and gated cases measuring Recall@K, Precision@K, and forbidden-hit rates.

memories.label: pluribus_mcp_empty_tags_failure
memories.statement: Empty MCP tags on recall requests caused over-broad lexical matches; tag-scoped compile now penalizes untagged queries that pull cross-domain noise.

memories.label: pluribus_deprecated_sqlite_constraint
memories.statement: SQLite was the original Pluribus memory store; it is superseded by the Postgres-backed control-plane store and must not be used for new deployments.

memories.label: pluribus_enforcement_gate_constraint
memories.statement: Enforcement gates block agent actions when governing constraints are violated; pre-change enforcement requires recall of active constraints before edits.

memories.label: pluribus_curation_promotion_pattern
memories.statement: Curation promotes repeated experiences into durable patterns only after confidence thresholds; one-off observations stay advisory until review_learnings confirms stability.

memories.label: pluribus_semantic_recall_state
memories.statement: Semantic recall hybrid path embeds retrieval queries when an embedder is available; lexical-only fallback remains the default in benchmark runs without embeddings.

memories.label: pluribus_memory_migration_pattern
memories.statement: Memory migrations move legacy archive/memory-bank content into Postgres objects with domain tags; superseded constraints keep status=superseded to avoid stale recall.

memories.label: dornan_pro_enterprise_marketing_pattern
memories.statement: Dornan Pro enterprise marketing positions fractional CTO services for mid-market SaaS with executive thought-leadership content and case-study driven outbound.

memories.label: dornan_pro_consulting_positioning_decision
memories.statement: Dornan Pro consulting focuses on product-engineering alignment workshops rather than staff augmentation; engagements are outcome-based retainers.

memories.label: dornan_pro_website_brand_pattern
memories.statement: The Dornan Pro website uses a dark executive aesthetic with proof points from Stanford-adjacent advisory work and a single primary CTA for discovery calls.

memories.label: dornan_pro_executive_advisory_state
memories.statement: Executive advisory positioning emphasizes board-ready memos, roadmap audits, and hiring-bar calibration for Series A–C startups.

memories.label: dornan_pro_client_engagement_failure
memories.statement: A fixed-scope website rewrite without discovery failed because stakeholders disagreed on ICP; now all engagements start with a two-week diagnostic.

memories.label: onguard_housing_badge_integration_fact
memories.statement: OnGuard integrates Stanford housing badge readers with mobile credential APIs so residents tap phones at dorm entrances instead of physical cards.

memories.label: onguard_integration_interface_pattern
memories.statement: OnGuard exposes a REST integration interface for housing systems to sync resident roster changes and push credential updates to badge controllers.

memories.label: onguard_stanford_housing_constraint
memories.statement: Stanford housing deployments must keep PII on-campus; external SaaS credential stores require IRB-style review before production use.

memories.label: onguard_databolt_harvester_pattern
memories.statement: The Databolt harvester ingests access-log batches from badge controllers, normalizes timestamps, and feeds anomaly detection for tailgating alerts.

memories.label: onguard_mobile_credential_decision
memories.statement: Mobile credential rollout chose BLE-first tap with NFC fallback because dorm readers were already BLE-capable from a prior pilot.

memories.label: nginx_reverse_proxy_pattern
memories.statement: Nginx reverse-proxies local services on 443 with upstream blocks per app; health checks use /healthz before marking upstreams active.

memories.label: nginx_apache_auth_constraint
memories.statement: Apache basic-auth protects legacy admin paths while Nginx terminates TLS; auth headers must not be stripped on proxy_pass to Apache backends.

memories.label: nginx_local_routing_state
memories.statement: Local routing sends /api to port 8080, /mcp to the control-plane sidecar, and static assets from /var/www with cache-bust query params in dev.

memories.label: nginx_ssl_termination_pattern
memories.statement: SSL termination at Nginx uses certbot renewals with OCSP stapling; internal upstreams stay HTTP on loopback to simplify cert rotation.

memories.label: homelab_proxmox_ceph_constraint
memories.statement: Proxmox VMs store disks on a three-node Ceph pool; never run single-replica pools for stateful services because host maintenance causes outages.

memories.label: homelab_docker_compose_ops_pattern
memories.statement: Docker Compose stacks use named volumes, healthcheck blocks, and restart unless-stopped; updates pull images on a weekly maintenance window.

memories.label: homelab_gpu_ollama_state
memories.statement: GPU Ollama runs on a dedicated LXC with passthrough; default model is qwen2.5-coder with 8192 context for local agent experiments.

memories.label: homelab_network_segmentation_decision
memories.statement: IoT VLAN is isolated from the services VLAN; only the reverse proxy VM has dual-homed access for homelab dashboards.

memories.label: comfyui_ltx_video_pattern
memories.statement: LTX video workflows in ComfyUI chain text encoder, latent diffusion, and frame interpolation nodes with fixed seed for reproducible clips.

memories.label: comfyui_lora_consistency_constraint
memories.statement: LoRA consistency requires matching base checkpoint and trigger token across train and infer graphs; mixing SD1.5 LoRAs with SDXL bases breaks faces.

memories.label: comfyui_animation_workflow_state
memories.statement: Animation workflow uses AnimateDiff with motion LoRA at 16fps export; batch size capped at 2 on 12GB VRAM to avoid OOM.

memories.label: comfyui_model_management_failure
memories.statement: Symlinking models into multiple ComfyUI roots caused duplicate loads and VRAM exhaustion; centralize models under one path with extra_model_paths.yaml.

memories.label: fitness_protein_intake_decision
memories.statement: Daily protein target is 160g spread across four meals with 40g post-workout shake within 30 minutes of lifting sessions.

memories.label: fitness_muscle_plan_pattern
memories.statement: Muscle plan alternates push/pull/legs with progressive overload logged in a spreadsheet; deload every fifth week at 60% working weight.

memories.label: fitness_exercise_routine_state
memories.statement: Current exercise routine runs Mon/Wed/Fri gym and Tue/Thu zone-2 cardio; Saturday is optional mobility work only.

memories.label: fitness_recovery_constraint
memories.statement: Minimum seven hours sleep is non-negotiable on lift days; skipping sleep voids heavy squat sessions to protect lower back.

memories.label: finance_budgeting_pattern
memories.statement: Monthly budgeting uses 50/30/20 with automated transfers on payday; discretionary spend tracked in a shared spreadsheet category.

memories.label: finance_investment_preference_decision
memories.statement: Investment preference favors low-cost index funds with 70/30 stock-bond allocation; individual stock picks capped at 5% of portfolio.

memories.label: finance_emergency_fund_constraint
memories.statement: Emergency fund must cover six months expenses in HYSA before increasing equity allocation above baseline.

memories.label: generic_interface_integration_noise
memories.statement: Systems should expose a clean interface for integration with external agents and services through standard binding layers.

memories.label: generic_api_surface_pattern
memories.statement: API surfaces benefit from consistent error shapes and versioned endpoints so integrators can rely on stable contracts.

memories.label: generic_system_binding_state
memories.statement: Binding system components through shared interfaces reduces coupling when teams integrate new modules.

memories.label: generic_data_pipeline_noise
memories.statement: Data pipelines should validate schema at ingress and emit metrics for downstream consumers.

memories.label: generic_agent_workflow_trap
memories.statement: Agent workflows improve when loops recall prior context before action and record outcomes after completion.

memories.label: generic_compliance_checklist_noise
memories.statement: Compliance checklists help teams gate releases when policy constraints must be verified before deployment.
